facts.business: Shri Dinesh Mills Limited manufactures paper maker's felts (technical textiles) for high-speed paper machines, serving domestic and export markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Sales turnover of Felts (Technical Textiles) is likely to be increased but net profit may remain under pressure due to global disruption during the current financial year.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts

key_risks: Rising raw material and energy costs
Increasing imports from ASEAN countries and China leading to pricing pressure
Dependence on imported specialty raw materials
Limited global brand visibility in premium applications
Intense competition from domestic and overseas suppliers
Volatility in raw material prices, logistics costs, exchange rates
Rapid technological advancements by multinational competitors
facts.related_party_note: Promoter disclosed execution of Family Settlement Agreement (FSA) on April 29, 2026 between Shri Bharatbhai Patel & Shri Aditya Patel (BUP Family) and Shri Nimishbhai Patel & Shri Nishank Patel (NUP Family).
